defs.def: to think about sth and try to decide what is true, what will happen, what you should do, etc. 想知道；想弄明白；琢磨

ex.s: Progress can be slow, and you’ll wonder if it’s all sinking in.
ex.t: 进步可能很慢，你会怀疑这一切是否真的被他们吸收了。

ex.s: There were times when I found myself wondering if I should pack it all in, but the boy’s words kept ringing in my ears: I knew I needed nothing else to succeed but a bit of ____54____ and hard work.
ex.t: 曾有段时间我怀疑自己是否该放弃，但男孩的话一直在我耳边回响：我知道要成功，除了一点____54____和努力，我别无所需。

ex.s: More than once, I found myself wondering just how my students, who’d created these people, knew their subjects so well.
ex.t: 不止一次，我发现自己想知道，创造了这些角色的我的学生们，怎么会如此了解他们所写的人物。

ex.s: It made me wonder if giving her advice on snacks was having an unintentionally negative impact.
ex.t: 这让我想知道，给她关于零食的建议是否在无意中产生了负面影响。

ex.s: One day, during a class in the IT lab with my classmates, our teacher mentioned missing computer parts. ____2____ looks exchanged, everyone wondered how it could happen in a(n) ____3____ lab.
ex.t: 有一天，在IT实验室和同学上课时，老师提到了丢失的电脑零件。____2____（目光）交换，大家都想知道这怎么会发生在一个____3____实验室里。

ex.s: Inspired by magical maps in her stories, she wondered: what if we could build a real-world app that helps people explore hidden places in their own cities?
ex.t: 受故事中神奇地图的启发，她想：如果我们能做一个现实世界的应用，帮助人们在自己城市里探索隐藏的地点，会怎样？

ex.s: They wondered out loud.
ex.t: 他们大声议论着。

ex.s: He didn’t seem to have done any reading ____29____ about my research, which made me wonder ____30____ he was truly interested in working with me.
ex.t: 他似乎没有读过任何关于我研究的____29____，这让我怀疑他是否真的有兴趣和我共事。

ex.s: Only this time I wondered: Why did I underline this sentence?
ex.t: 只是这一次我想知道：我为什么给这句话划了下划线？

ex.s: I’ve found myself wondering how we gain pleasure from art.
ex.t: 我发现自己好奇我们从艺术中获得愉悦的方式。

ex.s: Little wonder the Federal Duck Stamp Program has been called one of the most successful conservation programs ever initiated.
ex.t: 难怪联邦鸭票计划被称为最成功的保护项目之一。

ex.s: You can't help wondering how hard it ___61___ (be) for the people then to put all those rocks into place.
ex.t: 你不禁会想，当时那些人把所有这些石头就位有多___61___（困难）。

ex.s: He was thrilled to be doing the comedy that he always felt he should do, but even during his last few years, he always had a sense of curiosity, wondering what new role or challenge might be just around the corner.
ex.t: 他为自己能出演一直觉得应该演的喜剧而兴奋，但即使在生命的最后几年，他也始终保持着好奇心，想知道下一个新的角色或挑战可能就在眼前。

ex.s: One day they’ll   47   and discover that everything they’ve always known about windows is a   48  .I wonder if   49   should always tell the truth no matter the   50  .
ex.t: 有一天他们会___47___，发现他们一直以来对窗户的认知是个___48___。我想知道，不管___50___如何，我们是否都应该说真话。

ex.s: She wondered if centuries of diving could have led to the evolution of physical characteristics that made the task easier for them.
ex.t: 她想知道，数百年的潜水是否可能导致了身体特征的进化，从而让巴瑶人更轻松地完成这项工作。

ex.s: The second drawer began to fill and as it did I wondered whether there were bigger discoveries out there, not just species, but life that depends on things thought to be useless, life even without DNA.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉开始装满，就在它装满时我想知道外面是否还有更大的发现，不只是物种，还有依赖被认为无用的东西生存的生命，甚至没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: One may wonder how the Silence Machine works.
ex.t: 多亏了静音机——一项英国发明，你可以在不惹恼那个男孩或他父母的情况下消除那个声音。

ex.s: C．No wonderD．Enjoy yourself
ex.t: C．难怪 D．尽情享受

ex.s: 5．（1分）﹣I'm moving in a few days and I wonder if you could help．
ex.t: 5．（1分）—我几天后就要搬家了，不知你能否帮忙。

ex.s: Hit the streets with confidence. _____33_____ Say, “Excuse me, I work for XYZ News, and I was wondering if you could share your opinion about this topic.” This is a quick way to get people to warm up to you.
ex.t: 自信地上街。_____33_____说：“打扰一下，我为XYZ新闻工作，我想知道您能否分享一下对这个问题的看法。”这是让人对你放下戒备的快速方法。

ex.s: "I'm wondering what life is going to be like here." "Don't worry," he gave me a smile.
ex.t: “我想知道这里的生活会是什么样子。“别担心， ”他笑着对我说。

ex.s: He wondered if Peking Opera is easier Than a Shakespeare play to understand.
ex.t: 他想知道京剧是否比莎士比亚的戏剧更容易理解。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: Now, every year when my husband pulls our camper out of the garage, we are filled with a sense of _____54_____, wondering what camping fun and _____55_____ we will experience next.
ex.t: 现在，每年当我丈夫把露营车从车库开出来时，我们心中充满了_____54_____，想知道下次我们会经历什么样的露营乐趣和_____55_____。

defs.def: （礼貌地提问或请人做事时说）
to be very surprised by sth 感到诧异；非常惊讶

ex.s: Most of us， in fact， progressively narrow the variety of our lives． We succeed in our field of specialization and then become trapped in it． Nothing surprises us． We lose our sense of wonder． But， if we are willing to learn， the opportunities are everywhere．
ex.t: 事实上，我们大多数人都在逐渐缩小生活的多样性。我们在自己的专业领域取得成功，然后便被困其中。没有什么能让我们感到惊讶。我们失去了好奇心。但是，如果我们愿意学习，机会无处不在。

defs.def: a feeling of surprise and admiration that you have when you see or experience sth beautiful, unusual or unexpected 惊讶；惊奇；惊异；惊叹

ex.s: When he got older, John started to wonder if this process could be used to clean up the messes people were making.
ex.t: 长大后，约翰开始想这个过程是否可以用来清理人类制造的垃圾。

ex.s: The end result is a read in which we learn to wonder like Socrates, see like Thoreau, listen like Schopenhauer, and have no regrets like Nietzsche.
ex.t: 最终读到的，是我们学会像苏格拉底一样发问、像梭罗一样观察、像叔本华一样倾听、像尼采一样无怨无悔。

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 您还必须惊讶于一种独特的疯狂语言，在这种语言中，房子可以在燃烧时燃烧，您可以通过填写表格来填写表格，并且只有在警报响起时才会听到警报！

ex.s: It's a wonder they didn't walk out of the studio.
ex.t: 令人惊讶的是,他们没有走出工作室。

defs.def: something that fills you with surprise and admiration 奇迹；奇观；奇事；奇妙之处

ex.s: A passionate interest works wonders.
ex.t: 一种热忱的兴趣能创造奇迹。

ex.s: Growing up, my family and our neighbors never used clotheslines to dry clothing, denying me the chance ____62____ (discover) one of the great wonders of sunshine — the sweet “sunshine scent” after sunning clothes for an entire day.
ex.t: 成长过程中，我家和邻居从不使用晾衣绳晾衣服，使我失去了____62____（发现）阳光的一大奇迹的机会——把衣服晒上一整天后那甜美的“阳光味”。

ex.s: If you’ve never experienced the “sunshine scent” from a sheet or shirt ____65____ (leave) to sun for a day, well, you’re missing out on one of life’s wonders.
ex.t: 如果你从未体验过床单或衬衫上晒过太阳的____65____（留下/leave）一天的味道，那你可就错过了人生的一大奇迹。

ex.s: Old garden plots work WONDERS
ex.t: 传统花园地块创造奇迹

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: But for all its ancient buildings, Beijing is also a place ____43____ welcomes the fast-paced development of modern life, with 21st-century architectural ____44____ (wonder) standing side by side with historical buildings of the past.
ex.t: 但尽管有许多古建筑，北京也是一个____43____欢迎现代生活快节奏发展的地方，21世纪的建筑____44____（wonder）与过去的历史建筑比邻而立。

ex.s: In Samarkand, Mr Bissell admires the architectural wonders, while on his way to Bukhara he gets a taste of police methods when suspected of drug dealing.
ex.t: 在撒马尔罕，比塞尔先生欣赏建筑奇观，而在前往布哈拉途中，他因涉嫌毒品交易尝到了警察手段的滋味。

ex.s: A． anxious to do wonders
ex.t: A．急于创造奇迹

ex.s: A． fill our senses to feel the wonders of the world
ex.t: A．充分运用我们的感官去感受世界的奇迹

ex.s: For Pahlsson, its return was   65   wonder.
ex.t: 对于帕尔森来说，它的失而复返简直是____奇迹。

ex.s: Today, the Longji Rice Terraces attract thousands of visitors who come to admire this great wonder created by people and nature working together.
ex.t: 如今，龙脊梯田吸引成千上万游客前来欣赏人与自然共同创造的这一伟大奇迹。

defs.def: a person who is very clever at doing sth; a person or thing that seems very good or effective 能人；奇才；有特效的东西

ex.s: A child's day is filled with fascination， newness and wonder.
ex.t: 唤醒感官的第一步是停止在事情发生之前预测我们将要看到和感觉到的东西。

ex.s: As I swept up the mess, I wondered why we had been breaking so many things over the months.
ex.t: 当我在打扫残局时我想为什么这几个月来我们打破了这么多东西。
